values.name: Handling commission
values.description: Fee for the processing of documentary credit, collection and payment which are charged to the customer.

values.name: Amendment commission
values.description: Fee for amendments in documentary credit and collection business (not extensions and increases of documentary credits).

values.name: Acceptance commission
values.description: Fee for the acceptance of draft in documentary credit and collection business which are drawn on us (also to be seen as a kind of 'guarantee commission').

values.name: Commission for obtaining acceptance
values.description: Fee for obtaining an acceptance under collections on the basis of 'documents against acceptance'.

values.name: Commission on delivery
values.description: Fee for delivery of documents without corresponding payment.

values.name: Advising commission
values.description: Fee for advising documentary credits (charged also in case of confirmed credits).

values.name: Confirmation commission
values.description: Fee for confirmation of credit.

values.name: Deferred payment commission
values.description: Fee for the deferred payment period under documentary credits confirmed by bank. This fee are charges for the period from presentation of the document until due date of payment.

values.name: Commission for taking up documents
values.description: Fee charged to the foreign bank for the processing of documentary credit.

values.name: Opening commission
values.description: Fee for opening revocable documentary credit.

values.name: Fee for payment under reserve
values.description: Fee charged to the customer for discrepancies in credit documents in the case of which the bank have to stipulate payment under reserve.

values.name: Discrepancy fee
values.description: Fee charged to the foreign bank for discrepancies in credit documents.

values.name: Domicilation commission
values.description: Fee for the domicilation of bills with the bank.

values.name: Commission for release of goods
values.description: Commission for the release of goods sent to the bank.

values.name: Collection commission
values.description: Fee for settling collections on the basis of 'documents against payments'.

values.name: Negotiation commission
values.description: Fee for the purchase of documents under sight credit for the first ten days.

values.name: Return commission
values.description: Fee for cheques, bills and collections returned unpaid and/or recalled.

values.name: B/L splitting charges
values.description: Fee for the splitting of bills of lading.

values.name: Trust commission
values.description: Fee for the handling on a fiduciary basis of imported goods that have been warehoused.

values.name: Transfer commission
values.description: Fee for the transfer of transferable documentary credits.

values.name: Commission for opening irrevocable doc. credits
values.description: Fee for opening irrevocable documentary credits. This fee is a kind of 'Guarantee commission' as compensation for the commitment into which the bank have entered on the customers behalf; similar to confirmation commission, acceptance commission.

values.name: Pre-advice commission
values.description: Fee for the pre-advice of a documentary credit.

values.name: Supervisory commission
values.description: Fee for the supervising unconfirmed documentary credits with a deferred payment period.

values.name: Model charges
values.description: Fee for decoding telex messages.

values.name: Risk commission
values.description: Commission in addition to the confirmation commission for documentary credits from sensitive countries.

values.name: Guarantee commission
values.description: Commission for drawing up guaranties.

values.name: Reimbursement commission
values.description: Fee for reimbursement of, for example, documentary credits.

values.name: Stamp duty
values.description: Tax payable on bills in accordance with national bill of exchange legislations.

values.name: Brokerage
values.description: Brokers commission arising, in trade with foreign currencies.

values.name: Bank charges
values.description: Charges deducted/claimed by other banks involved in the transaction.

values.name: Bank charges information
values.description: Charges not included in the total charge amount i.e. the charges are for information only.

values.name: Courier fee
values.description: Fee for use of courier service.

values.name: Phone fee
values.description: Fee for use of phone.

values.name: Postage fee
values.description: Fee for postage.

values.name: S.W.I.F.T. fee
values.description: Fee for use of S.W.I.F.T.

values.name: Telex fee
values.description: Fee for telex.

values.name: Penalty for late delivery of documents
Penalty for late delivery of valuation of works
Penalty for execution of works behind schedule
Bonus for works ahead of schedule
Interest on arrears
values.description: Interest for late payment.

values.name: Interest
values.description: Cost of using money.

values.name: Charge per credit cover
values.description: Unit charge per credit cover established.

values.name: Charge per unused credit cover
values.description: Unit charge per unused credit cover.

values.name: Minimum commission
values.description: Minimum commission charge.

values.name: Factoring commission
values.description: Commission charged for factoring services.
